title: Deep Learning-Based Electrocardiogram Model (EIANet) to Predict Emergency Department Cardiac Arrest: Development and External Validation Study.
summary: EIANet predicts emergency-department cardiac arrest from triage ECG images; full text reports development plus independent two-hospital validation, with performance lower externally.
ai_technology: EIANet applies a spatial-attention network and recall-balanced loss to image-based triage ECGs to predict ED cardiac arrest.
organization: Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering

evidence.tested: The paper reports EIANet performance on 571 cases/826 controls at NTUH and an independent FEMH cohort of 378 cases/713 controls; external AUROC is 0.803.
evidence.unknown: Independent second-hospital retrospective evaluation is reported; the authors state prospective real-world testing remains future work.
evidence.ai_role: EIANet applies a spatial-attention network and recall-balanced loss to image-based triage ECGs to predict ED cardiac arrest.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
